originalTitle: Innovations from Google I/O 26 on Google Cloud
title: Innovations from Google I/O 26 on Google Cloud
oneSentenceSummary: Google I/O 26 announces a suite of new AI models and platform updates for Google Cloud, including Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Omni, the Antigravity platform, and the Gemini Spark personal agent, all aimed at powering the Agentic Enterprise.
summary: This article from the Google Cloud Blog summarizes the major AI and platform innovations announced at Google I/O 26. Key highlights include the release of Gemini 3.5 Flash, a frontier model optimized for agentic and coding tasks with superior performance and cost-efficiency; Gemini Omni, a groundbreaking multimodal model for generating and editing video content; and significant expansions to the Google Antigravity platform, including enterprise security features, a new desktop app, and a CLI. The article also introduces Gemini Spark, a 24/7 personal AI agent for enterprise users that can autonomously execute complex workflows across Workspace and other tools. Other announcements include new Workspace features like Google Pics for image generation and voice capabilities, the Managed Agents API for building custom agents, and CodeMender, an AI security agent for vulnerability detection and patching. The overarching theme is enabling the 'Agentic Enterprise' by providing a comprehensive platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents.
featuredReason: This is the broadest map of Google Cloud's I/O 26 AI announcements, covering Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini Omni, Antigravity, Gemini Spark, Managed Agents API, and CodeMender. Its value is in connecting models, agent infrastructure, enterprise security, and Workspace workflows into one strategy for the agentic enterprise.

mainPoints.point: Google releases Gemini 3.5 Flash, a new frontier model for agents and coding.
mainPoints.explanation: Gemini 3.5 Flash delivers frontier performance for complex, long-horizon tasks, outperforming previous models on key benchmarks like Terminal-Bench and MCP Atlas, while being cost-efficient.

mainPoints.point: Gemini Omni is a new multimodal model for video generation and editing.
mainPoints.explanation: This model can generate dynamic video content from text, audio, image, and video inputs, enabling intuitive video creation and editing for enterprise use cases like e-commerce and post-production.

mainPoints.point: Google Antigravity platform is expanded with enterprise features, a desktop app, and a CLI.
mainPoints.explanation: Antigravity now offers enterprise-grade security and compliance through integration with Agent Platform, a new Antigravity 2.0 desktop app for orchestrating agents, and a CLI for lightweight development.

mainPoints.point: Gemini Spark is a new 24/7 personal AI agent for enterprise users.
mainPoints.explanation: Spark can autonomously execute multi-step workflows across Workspace and other tools, learning user preferences and requiring approval for high-risk actions, all within a secure, governed sandbox.

mainPoints.point: New developer tools include Managed Agents API and CodeMender security agent.
mainPoints.explanation: The Managed Agents API allows developers to spin up custom agents in secure, Google-hosted environments, while CodeMender is an AI agent that autonomously finds and fixes code vulnerabilities.

keyQuotes: Gemini 3.5 Flash delivers frontier performance for agents and coding, excelling at complex long-horizon tasks that deliver real-world utility.
Gemini Omni is a groundbreaking new model that produces dynamic video content by blending text, audio, image, and video inputs.
Antigravity empowers the next era of enterprise builders. It enables your organization to transform how applications are built, deployed, and managed.
Gemini Spark in Gemini Enterprise is our new 24/7 personal agent that can work in the background across Workspace, custom connectors, and the open web.

CodeMender is an AI code security agent, originally developed by Google DeepMind. Leveraging Agent Platform capabilities and advanced Gemini models, CodeMender autonomously identifies vulnerabilities within your code.
